scope.final_state: independent read-only client and sink SQLite queries
scope.intermediate_state: per-row arithmetic and payload/receipt consistency of recorded snapshots; no separate historical DB copies
scope.base_ECRC_chain: sequence, predecessor, content hash and base-field consistency only; original expiry rule not applied to new durable grants
scope.extended_metadata: cross-checked with actual sink/job; not claimed to be covered by the original base receipt hash
scope.time: actual sink commit and local reconciliation times separate from injected authorization/reconciliation policy clocks
scope.process_crashes: recorded PID/nonzero exit checked; no new process failures injected by auditor
